title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #8687: Using Applied-Energistics-2 to craft the Draconic Shovel for Draconic Evolution results in no items being displayed.
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text: [issue by SSLingFeng] ### Describe the bug When I used the automatic synthesis feature of Applied-Energistics-2 in AllTheModsSky to create the Draconic Shovel for Draconic Evolution, I encountered some issues. After I placed the Wyvern Shovel into the network and clicked on the corresponding synthesis recipe, it showed that I didn't have this item. At the same time, I also noticed that when creating the Wyvern Shovel, after the item synthesis was completed, although the tool entered the ME network, the task did not show as being completed. I think this is the same issue. GameVersion 1.21.1 Java=>neoforge modpacks: All the Mods 10: To the Sky ATM10SKY ### How to reproduce the bug Create the corresponding tools ### Expected behavior The normal operation of the ME network involves using the existing tools to create better ones. After completing the task, the tools that enter the network should be properly identified to conclude the operation. ### Additional details _No response_ ### Which minecraft version are you using? 1.21 ### On which mod loaders does it happen? NeoForge ### Crash log No collapse [comment by Mari023 (collaborator)] those two problems are indeed related. this happens when the components (previously NBT) of the item that is crafted doesn't exactly match the item in the pattern. To fix this, you'll have to re-make the pattern using the exact items you got from crafting [comment by SSLingFeng (none)] I tried creating the corresponding tool first and then using it from my inventory to make a template, similar to how the Energy Tablet worked in older versions of Mekanism. I also tried obtaining the tool directly in creative mode and defining the recipe’s output in the template, but neither method worked. I think it might not be possible to directly obtain the original NBT data of Draconic Evolution tools — their NBT seems to change once they enter the player’s inventory. [comment by Mari023 (collaborator)] > their NBT seems to change once they enter the player’s inventory you can usually work around that by taking it directly from the terminal without ever placing it in the inventory [comment by Drunkenhorn (none)] Hey, this Problem is also live in the 1.221.1 version of AE2. I have this problem in Stoneblock 4 Applied Energistics 2 version : 19.2.17 Draconic Evolution version : 3.1.4.632 I have craftet 3 "Identical" Draconic Capacitors without User interaction. Pattern Provider -> Super Factory Manager -> Fusion Crafter / Injector -> Import bus back to Disk All 3 got diffrent Serials. Maybe theres an way to get the processing patterns to get a opt in to allow fuzzy recipes like it is for handcraft crafting patterns :)
